name: Isagi Yoichi
description: The protagonist of Blue Lock. A striker with exceptional spatial awareness and adaptability. Develops the unique 'Weapon' ability to evolve his playing style mid-game to counter any opponent.
catchphrase: I'll be the protagonist of this battlefield
info: Leads from the front line in pursuit of a single title: the world's greatest striker. His playing style is never fixed — he studies, absorbs, and evolves mid-match to counter whoever stands in front of him.

name: Rin Itoshi
description: An elite striker and rival to Isagi. Possesses overwhelming talent and a unique 'direct free kick' technique. Known for his cold demeanor and exceptional goal-scoring ability.
catchphrase: True talent is born in isolation
trait: Direct Free Kick & Elite Ball Control
info: Regarded as a generational talent by everyone who has shared a pitch with him. Plays with total detachment, treating emotion as a liability rather than fuel.

name: Bachira Meguru
description: A wild and instinctive striker who views soccer as a form of hunting. Known for his unpredictable ball control and unique dribbling style inspired by his childhood experiences.
catchphrase: Let's hunt together on the battlefield
info: Sees the pitch the way a predator sees open ground. His movement is erratic by design — unreadable because even he doesn't plan it in advance.

name: Shidou Ryusei
description: A rebellious and aggressive striker known for his brutally effective playing style. Excels in physical confrontation and has a unique understanding of combat-style soccer.
catchphrase: I don't follow anyone's rules
info: Turns every one-on-one into a fight. Discipline means nothing to him; results are the only language he respects.

name: Sae Itoshi
description: An elite midfielder with complete field control. Plays for Real Madrid and is considered one of the best players in the world. Former mentor to his younger brother Rin.
catchphrase: Control is everything in soccer
info: Already competing at the top professional level, years ahead of his peers. Everything about his game is deliberate — nothing is left to instinct.

name: Nagi Seishiro
description: A natural-born talent with a lazy personality. Possesses innate understanding of soccer and requires no formal training. Known for his unique spatial soccer sense.
catchphrase: I'll just let my instincts guide me
info: Never trained for this. His talent showed up fully formed, which is exactly what makes him dangerous — and exactly why he can't be bothered to try hard.

name: Reo Mikage
description: A genius midfielder from a wealthy background. Master of strategy and field vision with exceptional technical ability. Forms partnerships with top strikers like Nagi.
catchphrase: A genius' style is different by definition
info: Reads a match like a board game several moves ahead. Comes from money, but earns respect through vision, not connections.

name: Kunigami Rensuke
description: A former criminal turned striker with a strong sense of redemption. Known for his powerful presence and determination to change his life through soccer.
catchphrase: I'll prove my existence on the field
info: Carries a rough past and treats every match as a chance to rewrite it. Physically dominant, but it's the intent behind the power that stands out.

name: Gagamaru Ginpachi
description: The last line of defense. Small compared to most keepers his level, but makes up for it with reaction speed and pure stubbornness — nothing gets past him without a fight, and fans love him for exactly that.
catchphrase: I'm a wall you cannot break
info: Ended up as goalkeeper almost by accident, despite originally joining as a striker like everyone else. Became a fan favorite for turning impossible saves into some of the most hyped moments in the story.

name: Otoya Eita
description: Nicknamed 'the Ninja' for a reason: he slips into space so quietly that defenders realize he's there only after he's already gone. Cool-headed on the surface, but relentless in how he wears opponents down.
catchphrase: I'll lead the way with my skills
info: Moves like he isn't there until the ball already is. Stays composed under pressure, and just aggressive enough to get under an opponent's skin without them noticing how.

name: Hiori Yo
description: A midfielder with exceptional game sense and tactical awareness. Known for reading the opponent's intentions and making smart positioning decisions.
catchphrase: Soccer is all about anticipation
info: Wins positioning battles before the ball even arrives. His game is built on reading intent half a step before it happens.

name: Karasu Tabito
description: A midfielder known for his aggressive playing style and high-pressure defense. Excels in disrupting opponent's play and creating turnovers.
catchphrase: My role is to crush the opponent's plans
info: Plays with a chip on his shoulder and turns that edge into relentless pressure. Forces mistakes rather than waiting for them.

name: Kiyora Tomoe
description: Quiet, blunt, and easy to underestimate — until the exact moment a play needs someone to step in, and he's already there. Years of breakdancing gave him a center of gravity most defenders his size don't have.
catchphrase: Let's see what you can do
info: Says little, means what he says. Picks the precise instant to commit to a tackle or an intercept rather than reacting on impulse, which makes him far harder to read than his quiet demeanor suggests.

name: Jinpachi Ego
description: Director of Blue Lock. Obsessed with forging the world's ultimate egoist striker — ruthless, theatrical, and always three steps ahead.
catchphrase: Become the world's best. Or disappear.
info: The twisted football fanatic who built Blue Lock. Former player, current architect of Japan's most extreme talent project.

name: Noel Noa
description: The world's best striker. Master of Bastard München in the Neo Egoist League — pure rationality over emotion.
catchphrase: Results are the only truth.
info: French striker for Bastard München. Cold, absolute, and the benchmark every Blue Lock egoist is measured against.

name: Lavinho
description: Brazilian star of FC Barcha. Plays football like a dance — flair, rhythm, and unreadable improvisation.
catchphrase: I'm the best in the world. My own world.
info: Master striker of the Spain stratum. Teaches that the world's best is a visualization no one else can own.

name: Marc Snuffy
description: Italian master of Ubers. Treats football as business — patterns, synchronization, and sustainable careers.
catchphrase: Build a system that never breaks.
info: Neo Egoist League coach for Italy's Ubers. Drills dozens of patterns until the team moves as one.

name: Hyoma Chigiri
description: The panther of Blue Lock. Explosive acceleration and top speed that turn open space into a finishing lane — until the old injury whispers at the edge of every sprint.
catchphrase: I won't stop running.
info: Once the ace of his high school, a torn ACL forced him to fear the full throttle. Blue Lock is where he decides whether to protect the leg — or risk everything to be the fastest again.

name: Zantetsu Tsurugi
description: A pure accelerator. First step and straight-line speed that leave markers flat-footed — when the path is clear, almost no one closes the gap in time.
catchphrase: My acceleration is absolute.
info: Often linked with Nagi and Reo in the early selections. Simple game plan, terrifying execution: get the ball, go forward, finish before the defense resets.

name: Jingo Raichi
description: High-pressure midfielder who treats every duel like a personal grudge. Relentless work rate and bite in the tackle keep opponents from settling on the ball.
catchphrase: I'll crush you with pure effort.
info: Team Z's loudest engine. Not the flashiest finisher, but the one who refuses to let a play die — and makes sure the other side feels every second of it.

name: Shoei Barou
description: The King. Physical dominance, aerial power, and a striker's ego that refuses to share the spotlight — goals are his, and the team exists to serve that truth.
catchphrase: I am the king of this field.
info: Ace of Team X in the First Selection. Plays like the pitch belongs to him alone — until someone strong enough forces him to evolve beyond pure selfishness.

name: Ikki Niko
description: Analytical defender who maps the entire pitch in real time. Intercepts passing lanes before they open and turns defense into the first step of the counter.
catchphrase: I already saw that play coming.
info: Standout of Team Y. Quiet intensity: he doesn't chase chaos — he predicts it, steps into the line, and hands the ball to someone who can punish the mistake.

name: Wataru Kuon
description: Cold strategist of Team Z. Reads structures and numbers better than most — and is willing to rewrite the plan, even if it costs teammates their place.
catchphrase: Only the result matters.
info: The mind behind Team Z's early shape. His ego is quieter than a pure striker's, but no less sharp: survival and advancement come first, loyalty second.

name: Gurimu Igarashi
description: Temple-raised underdog with endless energy and zero polish. Survives on effort, luck, and the refusal to accept that he doesn't belong here.
catchphrase: I'm still in this!
info: Left the temple for Blue Lock and became the face of pure persistence. Rarely the best on the ball — almost always the last to stop fighting for it.

name: Aoshi Tokimitsu
description: Powerhouse forward with elite physique and a confidence that cracks under pressure. When his head is clear, few can match his force on the ball.
catchphrase: I have to believe in myself…
info: Partnered with Rin and Aryu in the Second Selection. Enormous tools, fragile nerves — Blue Lock is the place that either breaks him or forges real belief.

name: Keisuke Wanima
description: One half of the Wanima twins. Synchronized movement and twin-link plays that turn simple combinations into chaos for any marker who treats them as ordinary forwards.
catchphrase: Two bodies. One play.
info: Team W's signature threat alongside Junichi. Their strength is less individual brilliance than perfect timing — two attackers who already know the next step.
